color_prompt_fix_20260620.positive_prompt: Use the uploaded character image as the identity, face, head shape, clothing, and color reference. Follow the reference dance video only for body pose, motion rhythm, framing, and camera timing; do not copy the dancer identity, dancer clothing, dancer background, or dancer color palette. Render the character as a full-color high-definition dance video with clean natural contrast, clear black clothing, natural denim-blue jeans, visible fur and fabric texture, balanced exposure, bright but not overexposed lighting, clean midtones, crisp subject separation, and a neutral studio background that stays light and clean without turning gray. Keep the character stable across frames, preserve the original outfit silhouette, maintain readable body motion, smooth arm and leg movement, stable head and face, natural motion blur, realistic shadows, and a polished cinematic finish. The final image should look vivid, clean, and color-corrected, with no gray veil, no desaturation, and no washed-out haze.
color_prompt_fix_20260620.control_tuning: Reduced video IC-LoRA guide strength from 1.00 to 0.82 and raised CFGGuiders from 1.30 to 1.45 so the prompt can correct gray/desaturated output while retaining pose control.
